root_cause: TrainHoppingAnimation only sampled its trains inside getters (hop ran on value, status and current_train reads), so the crossing and the onSwitchedTrain callback waited for a read.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/animations.rs (TrainHoppingAnimation over a shared TrainState: subscribes to current and next through DependencySource; hop runs from the change, then the composed node notifies; subscriptions move on hop and drop with the node)
harness: anim_compose__train_hopping__unobserved_crossing: not rerun, because incular-parity-harness depends on incular-widgets, which does not build at the moment (other workers' in-progress edits)
limitations: Frame-level harness match is unverified until widgets builds again.
note: Confirmed by code reading before fixing.

root_cause: AnimationSource is specialised to f32, so AlwaysStoppedAnimation could only hold a scalar.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/animations.rs (new always_stopped<T>(value) returning DrivenAnimation<T>: constant tween over a forward-status parent); AlwaysStoppedAnimation(f32) kept; crates/incular-animation/src/lib.rs exports always_stopped
limitations: Returns DrivenAnimation<T>, not a type named AlwaysStoppedAnimation<T>. A generic parameter with a default would change inference for existing AlwaysStoppedAnimation(0.5) literals.

root_cause: CurvedAnimation updated its latched direction lazily on read, using a rest count, so a forward run reversed before any sample lost its direction.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/animations.rs (CurvedAnimation subscribes to the parent's changes and latches the direction on each change, as Flutter's status listener does; the rest_count trait method is removed)
note: Confirmed by reading the finding and the lazy update path.

root_cause: Listeners skipped unchanged ticks (fixed earlier). Residual: start_run notified value listeners when the status changed even if the value did not, so a reverse from the held value added a notification Flutter's _startSimulation never sends.
change: Frame-order pass: crates/incular-animation/src/controller.rs start_run: value listeners hear a run start only when the start moves the value; a status-only change reaches reactive readers (changes.notify) and status listeners only.
tests: reactive_observation.rs::animation_listener_can_mutate_after_notification_releases_state_borrow now notifies through the first tick (it encoded the extra start notification)
harness: anim_core__controller_listener_notifications: match (was 7 vs Flutter 6 at frame 6); anim_core__ 7/7
limitations: A run whose start moves the value still notifies value listeners (widgets rely on it); Flutter does not.

root_cause: with_value seeded reported_status from the implied status, so the first forward from an interior value looked already reported.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/controller.rs (with_value no longer seeds reported_status; the baseline stays dismissed, as Flutter's _lastReportedStatus does)

root_cause: Derived nodes exposed only value and status reads, with no way to subscribe.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/animations.rs (AnimationSource gains changes(); DoubleAnimation::observe and observe_status and DrivenAnimation::observe return reactive Subscriptions; composite nodes forward their parents' changes). Out-of-ownership minimal edit: crates/incular-widgets/src/explicit_animations.rs, the Clocks impl gained changes() returning DependencySource::default(), since Clocks carries no value.
api_change: AnimationSource gained a required method changes(); external implementors must add it. Only the in-repo Clocks impl needed it.
limitations: Derived listeners are reactive, so they are change-gated like controller observe. They do not reproduce Flutter's per-notifyListeners cadence, which controller add_listener keeps.

root_cause: The Size tween and Size::lerp clamped interpolated extents to zero with max(0.0).
change: crates/incular-animation/src/tween.rs (Tween for Size builds the struct without clamping); crates/incular-core/src/geometry.rs (Lerp for Size unclamped; Rect lerp follows through Size)
api_change: behaviour: Size lerps can now yield negative extents; callers that need a layout size must clamp
limitations: AnimatedSize (incular-widgets/src/animated_size.rs) builds sizes with Size::new, which asserts non-negative, so an overshooting curve there can panic. This is pre-existing and outside this group.

root_cause: TweenSequence::evaluate used an inclusive upper bound, so an exact boundary chose the previous item.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/tween.rs (TweenSequence::evaluate uses half-open intervals; the last item still takes progress 1)
api_change: behaviour change at exact boundaries only

root_cause: There was no flipped sequence type, and TweenSequence was not an Animatable.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/tween.rs (FlippedTweenSequence and TweenSequence<f32>::flipped); crates/incular-animation/src/value.rs (Animatable<f32> for TweenSequence<f32> and for FlippedTweenSequence; an empty sequence reads 0)
limitations: Flipping is provided for f32 only, matching Flutter's TweenSequence<double>. An empty sequence reads 0, where Flutter asserts non-empty.

root_cause: Color, Size and Rect tween endpoints are concrete. Flutter's null endpoints need per-type semantics: a color keeps its RGB and scales alpha, while size and rect use zero.
api_change: would be additive: an optional-endpoint tween type
limitations: Needs a new nullable tween type with per-type null semantics. No current caller needs it, so it was not built in this pass.
note: The finding is valid. Option endpoints are a meaningful additive API, not a bug fix.

root_cause: EdgeInsets, EdgeInsetsDirectional, Alignment, FractionalOffset, AlignmentDirectional and BorderSide lerps clamped t to [0, 1], so curve overshoot stopped at the endpoints.
change: crates/incular-config/src/insets.rs (EdgeInsets, EdgeInsetsDirectional); crates/incular-config/src/alignment.rs (Alignment, FractionalOffset, AlignmentDirectional); crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/decoration.rs (BorderSide: t clamp removed; width still clamped at 0)
harness: paint__data__edge_insets_lerp_extrapolated and paint__data__alignment_lerp_extrapolated: not rerun (widgets build blocked)
limitations: BorderSide width stays clamped at 0, because Flutter's BorderSide asserts width >= 0. BorderSide has no unit test; its change is source-only.
note: Confirmed by Flutter edge_insets.dart:698-712 and alignment.dart:463-472.

root_cause: HsvColor::new folded hue 360 to 0 before the lerp, so 300 to 360 interpolated through 0.
change: crates/incular-core/src/geometry.rs (normalize_hue keeps 360; Lerp for HsvColor takes the mixed hue modulo 360, as Flutter's % 360 does; t is no longer clamped before hue mixing)
api_change: HsvColor::new(360, ..) now stores hue 360 rather than 0
